production_routes.message_hook: Type A: hook-presentation router (peek/full thread/lock screen/preview card/thread+floating hook); base = approved iOS Messages screenshot; ChatGPT localized text edit; floating TikTok hook adds new context only
production_routes.commerce_ui: Type B: closest approved real reference as BASE + real product INGREDIENT images; change only listed fields; if base can't fit, pick another real base, never squeeze/rebuild
production_routes.camera_roll: Type C: visual search first (Pinterest short queries); CLEARED BASE -> localized edit, else REFERENCE ONLY -> new original scene matching framing/light/density; real object photos for every added item
production_routes.new_scene: Type D: only when no base exists

core_rules: Story before commerce; commerce discovered secondarily
Reference Is Law for native visual structure/UI behavior; story values come from STORY_LOCK
Base first, smallest edit; re-edit from original base
Hook is not propulsion; 'why would they do that?' test
0-3 story-native micro-details per slide; comment-door map
Cross-slide congruency ledger + state-transition test; temporal compression
Latest human-approved STORY_LOCK wins; superseded assets STALE
Research never invents evidence; creative may be staged (labeled FICTIONAL/STAGED)
Use current product generations; verify live
Attach real reference photo for any object added to an image
